text: {"lessons":["The buys of A, B, and C and sale of D were followed by further losses, but that sequence does not show the trades caused them or predict what comes next.","My account has fallen from its earlier value, so I should assess risk and diversification against my plan rather than react to losses or try to recover them quickly.","Before each trade, I should check whether it improves my portfolio's intended allocation; frequent checking and recent price moves alone are not reasons to trade."]}
